label: Research
title: Five research programs, one technical direction.
description: Neryva's research spans multiple domains because efficiency, reliability, transfer, and optimization are cross-domain problems. We study how AI systems can become more efficient, more reliable, and more deployable under real operational constraints.

items.title: Language Systems
items.description: We investigate how language models can be adapted, structured, served, and extended so they behave more usefully in real systems.

items.title: Robotics and Task Transfer
items.description: We study how learned skills transfer across tasks, tools, and physical environments.

items.title: Biomedical, Biological, and Clinical AI
items.description: We study AI systems for clinical, biological, and life-science problems where correctness, validation, and supervision matter.

items.title: Energy Systems
items.description: We apply AI to complex physical and resource-constrained energy environments.

items.title: Computational Science and Engineering
items.description: We study how computational methods can support engineering decisions, simulation, design constraints, and diagnostics.
